description: A painted, dimly lit tree-lined street seen from the middle of the road. A white Volkswagen Beetle is parked on the left and dark vintage cars sit further down. On the right is a row of white stucco townhouses behind a low brick wall. In the foreground a zebra crossing runs across the frame, with dark footprint-like shadows on the white stripes. No people, no visible text, and the painting fills the whole image edge to edge.
